title: First match
hints: "First" means first in the **input**, not first to finish. So don't decide inside the goroutines: just record every answer, then look at them in order.
`matched := make([]bool, len(items))`; goroutine `i` does `matched[i] = pred(item)`. After `wg.Wait()`, scan `matched` from the start for the first `true`.

`for i, item := range items { wg.Go(func() { matched[i] = pred(item) }) }; wg.Wait(); return slices.Index(matched, true)`. `slices.Index` already returns `-1` when there's no `true` (and for an empty slice).
